Tablemint

Lemon garlic chicken

A weeknight roast chicken with a sharp lemon and garlic pan sauce that comes together in one dish.

Ingredients

  • 4 chicken thighs
  • 3 cloves garlic
  • 1 lemon
  • 2 tbsp olive oil
  • thyme

Method

  1. Season the chicken.
  2. Sear skin-side down.
  3. Add lemon and bake.
